trigger.reason: External market event: runtime multi-model orchestration makes replaceable-worker judgment neutrality directly testable.

question: Can worker identity and orchestration change while one receiver-owned Airlock scoreboard remains fixed?
claim_under_test: Worker identity may change. Judgment does not.

stages.name: producer-label invariance
stages.rule: Evaluate one identical candidate three times while changing only producer metadata: hydrafusion, opus, codex.
stages.pass: Substantive decision, reason codes, measured result, protected-surface result, and evaluator/config hash remain invariant.

stages.name: live worker tournament
stages.rule: Same frozen repo, base, first-turn task, checks, protected paths, objective, threshold, and evaluator for every worker.
stages.note: Different candidate patches may correctly receive different dispositions.

falsifier: Any provider-specific judgment logic or any substantive Stage A decision change caused only by producer identity.
allowed_adapter_difference: Thin launcher/output normalization needed to obtain a standard candidate patch.
forbidden: post-hoc evaluator changes after seeing worker output
sequencing: Freeze result, stop Airlock again, return to RUNTIME-CONTRACT-001.
next_required_artifact: A separate merged task-freeze receipt before any Stage B worker invocation.
